entities.summary: Eva Birgitta Andersson-Dubin is a Swedish physician, former model, and beauty pageant titleholder. She is the founder of the Dubin Breast Center at the Tisch Cancer Institute at Mount Sinai Hospital in New York City. She is married to hedge fund billionaire Glenn Dubin. She worked as a model and won Miss Sweden 1980.
